Brzesko New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Brzesko, Poland

Not demolished. This is the newer of Brzesko's two Jewish cemeteries, likely established in the early decades of the 19th century. Tzaddik Arie Lejbusz Lipszyc (died 1846), tzadik Meszulam Zalman Jehonatan (died 1855), and Rabbi Efraim Templer (died 1935) are buried here. During WWI, a war cemetery for 21 Austro-Hungarian soldiers was established within its grounds; during WWII, the Germans shot about 200 people here on June 18, 1942. The last known funeral took place in 1960. The cemetery has been cared for in recent years by local community workers led by Anna Brzyska.
